findings.description: William Honeyman (Hunneman) of Hutton Rudby, the weaver buried at Rudby in March 1783, was baptised at Hutton Rudby, Yorkshire, on 5 April 1719 as the son of William Hunneman.
supporting_sources: Hutton Rudby parish register: baptism of William son of William Hunnyman, 5 Apr 1719, between the baptisms of siblings Ralph (25 May 1717) and Eliz. (1 Jan 1720/21)

findings.description: William Honeyman (Hunneman) no longer carries the family's claimed christening on 2 December 1716 at Edinburgh or the claimed birth in 1716 at Edinburgh: that Edinburgh baptism belongs to a different child (son of William Honniman and Elizabeth Duncan), and its removal rests on records rather than on the tree's own facts.

details.expected_outcome: No 2 December 1716 Edinburgh christening and no 1716 Edinburgh birth on this person

supporting_sources: Scotland baptism index: William, son of William Honniman and Elizabeth Duncan, Edinburgh, 2 Dec 1716
Hutton Rudby parish register: sibling Ralph baptised 25 May 1717, five months later, to the same Hutton Rudby father

findings.description: The father's origin in Fife, including the tree's christening at Scoonie on 8 May 1692, is left as not proved rather than concluded, with the reason stated (no record names his origin, the Scoonie christening is not found, or it conflicts with his other facts).
supporting_sources: Scotland baptism indexes searched for William Honeyman c. 1670–1695: no Scoonie 1692 entry
Scoonie baptisms 1724–1729 of four children of a William Honeyman and Janet Blyth
